title: Modesto Children's Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Modesto Children’s Museum is proud to offer discounted admission options for visitors who are identified as low income, defined as receiving SNAP / EBT benefits (“CalFresh” in California). For families receiving SNAP benefits who wish to utilize this program, admission to the Modesto Children’s Museum is half price, including children (ages 1+) and adults. Tickets are available online and pre-purchase is highly recommended. To purchase or redeem pre-purchased SNAP / EBT admission, an adult member of the visiting party must present a SNAP / EBT card with their name and a matching photo ID. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: MoChiMu Field Trips invite your students to bring their creativity and critical thinking to life in a laboratory of play-based learning! Art, science, and imagination combine in ten exhibit areas. Explore systems in a Water Lab based on the Central Valley; become bees and “buzz” through an almond orchard labyrinth; experiment with wind in an open-inquiry Air Lab; become an artist in a Maker Lab, and much more! Field Trips are available for an “AM Session” from 9:00AM-11:00AM or a “PM Session” from 12:00-2:00PM.
